content.stem: 一位反洗钱合规官正在起草计划，以解决独立审计中发现的缺陷。哪种方法是最佳选择？

options.A: 只承诺实施那些无需新增投资即可实现股东价值最大化的行动计划
options.B: 与所在辖区的金融情报机构协商起草行动计划，以与其他类似公司保持一致
options.C: 只承诺在三个月的管理报告周期内能够实施并完成的行动计划
options.D: 起草行动计划以解决缺陷的根本原因，无论全面实施这些计划需要多长时间

content.stem_en: An AML compliance officer is drafting plans to address deficiencies identified in an independent audit. Which approach is the best option?

options_en.A: Only commit to action plans that require no new investment to maximize shareholder value
options_en.B: Draft action plans in consultation with the jurisdiction's FIU to remain aligned with other similar companies
options_en.C: Only commit to action plans that can be implemented and closed within the three-month management reporting cycle
options_en.D: Draft action plans to address the root cause of the deficiencies, regardless of how long they will take to fully implement
